Story

From rock nights to house

  1. 2010Starts DJing underground rock and pop nights in Rio while working as a journalist.
  2. 2017After a two-year residency at Copacabana Palace, goes all in on music.
  3. 2019Starts studying production and focuses only on her electronic project.
  4. 2025Places three times in Tomorrowland's global contests and plays Tomorrowland Brasil as a guest.
  5. 2026Wins the Lady of the House label contest and releases the official Rockixe remix.

Resident at Manie Dansante in Rio. Fifteen years of dance floors, now with house music as the whole point.
